However, my recent consultation with Dr. Mark Jones was extremely upsetting. I felt that my symptoms and pain were downplayed despite explaining in detail how my condition affects my daily life, work, and even causes episodes of collapse.

Some information documented in my medical notes did not accurately reflect what I said, which left me feeling dismissed and concerned about my care. During the consultation, I was also told that I was disturbing the emergency line, even though I had followed the process advised by the reception staff to speak to a doctor about my concerns.

I hope the practice reflects on this experience to ensure patients feel heard, supported, and that medical records accurately reflect consultations.
